decisions.reason: The vegan drink mix sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy direction and has little visible commitment behind it, but it was launched only a year ago and weak early sales can still be put down to start-up effects, so management keeps it for now.
The modular plant extensions fit the announced waste-to-energy direction and build on investment already made in the core plants, so management stays with them despite limited exposure.
The waste oil plant has its own website page, which signals the strongest public commitment and the most invested effort, so management persists with it as a flagship of the firm's direction.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is central to the firm's announced waste-to-energy strategy, and its long sales cycles let management treat slow uptake as temporary, so it keeps the product.
